pageSubtitle: Choose how you want to analyze your project.

githubOption.title: GitHub Repository
githubOption.description: Connect a repository for continuous scans, rescans, and history.

uploadOption.title: Upload a project
uploadOption.description: Drop a ZIP file for a one-time security analysis. No repository required.

localOption.title: Local Analysis
localOption.description: Analyze a project folder on this device. Nothing leaves your browser except the source files you select.

local.hint: Analyzes the files in your browser's memory only — no separate agent or install required.
local.unsupported: Local folder selection isn't supported in this browser. Use Upload (ZIP) instead.

preflight.too_many_files: Project is too large to analyze. It has more than {maxFiles} files, the beta limit.
preflight.total_too_large: Project is too large to analyze. Its total size is over the {maxTotalMb} MB beta limit.
preflight.file_too_large: Project is too large to analyze. It contains a file larger than the {maxFileMb} MB per-file limit.

analyzingHint: Running the same security scanner used for GitHub projects. This usually takes under a minute.
successRedirecting: Analysis complete. Opening your Production Verdict…

errors.too_large: This file is larger than the 8 MB beta limit.
